hypothesis: A shared trainable non-transformer tag-conditioned set learner, given public per-role causal instructions and noisy A cues but no conditional-law labels, will zero-shot transfer the known physical mux OPERATOR to a never-trained assignment of which four roles select/serve as branch targets. Test against fully trained MLP, GRU, native hard-router+TTT and shuffled/tag-removed controls; evaluate delayed cold and same-world assignment change.

source.true_law: On fresh pure R85 test physics, independently redraw four A factor signs [-1,+1] from new independent source RNG, overriding original index parity, set law_a = A[yes] if A[selector] positive else A[no], with public per-A-role instruction tags {selector:1, yes:2, no:3, distractor:0}. Never inject hidden law into public input.
source.public_information: Physical original 224-tick world, only 48 legally selected public prefix rows; four actually observed noisy A PROBE response rows encoded public role identity and normalized instruction tag at row[8], noisy A factor at row[10], phase at [11]; final pivot has actual selected intervention/time. All architectures get identical lawful public facts; no hidden law or unchosen return.
source.tag_protocol: Embed instruction tags in observed A-probe response channel 8 AFTER pure R85 pre-intervention physical rollout but BEFORE pure R86 48-row public compression, not in private labels. This public task instruction is essential: no model can identify unseen law from four A cues alone. Canonical readout can reorder by tag only as labeled engineering upper bound.
source.factual_training: Only one physically realized chosen intervention and its nine-tick return per FIT/VALID world, original selected action CALIBRATE iff ((index//4)+seed_index)%2==0 else EXPLOIT_POS; no other branch.
source.heldout_first_use: No DEV_SEEN, DEV_HELDOUT, OOD_SHIFT or ROLE_REASSIGN physical world materialized before ALL nine fully trained arm weights frozen; evaluator only creates new paired counterfactual actions after freeze, no updates.
source.OOD_scope: Unseen binding with known mux rule, 68/208 shifted pivots/probe timing/noise; not unfamiliar causal OPERATOR and not full 224-tokenless memory rollouts. Original 224 ticks condensed into 48 public selected rows and 5 extracted A/action slots.
source.reassignment: On fresh heldout assignment world, keep identical A factors, B factors, noise, physical time and chosen action but switch public task binding to [0,1,2] and recompute the true physical mux law; compare actions and realized returns against private paired physical evaluator, never use counterfactual branch in training.
source.negative: Public instruction tags ONLY are randomized by a seed/panel/world-index permutation among the four A roles, while raw cues/actions/return remain fixed. This disrupts correct task binding but CANNOT erase permutation-invariant signal: exact binary enumeration across four-factor configurations and all 24 tag permutations yields expected 62.5% implied-law agreement, NOT 50%. This is an honest role-binding disruption negative, not an independent causal-information destroying control. Also compare tag-blind raw-cue MLP and strong fully trained MLP/GRU. Permutations must never be chosen after target/source inspection.
source.law_independence: For each fresh new panel, private law positive frequency in pivot and chosen action strata must lie [.38,.62]; original index-derived R85 law never used as teacher; no source labels used for model supervision.

architecture.native: Existing original nontransformer R74 HybridPilot_FULL width32 and equivalent R75 triangular TTT from R95._native; three independently re-created identical native initial tensors; no change to original native source.
architecture.flat_sidecar: 12D raw flatten (four actually observed noisy A, four public tags, chosen action flags, time and zero) conventional MLP64 head added to original native value.
architecture.tagged_set: Trainable shared per-role MLP consumes (noisy cue, one-hot of observed public tag) for each of four observed A events, commutative sum pooled latent, final MLP with observed action/time produces factual return; no hardcoded mux or private-law teacher and no transformer/tokenization.
architecture.tagged_set_sidecar: Same tagged-set head added to original unmodified native pivot value, separately experimental, cannot prove native core learned role transfer.
architecture.raw_MLP: 12D flattened raw-cue and tag feature MLP64, 12->64->64->1, strong conventional fully trained same factual examples.
architecture.blind_MLP: Identical 12D MLP64 with four public instruction tag slots zeroed; cannot know unknown binding, negative baseline.
architecture.tag_permuted: Same initialized trainable set architecture/params as actual tagged-set arm, but public tags only randomized per world, preserving factual return, causal noisy cue, role identity, action, time and tag histogram; no shuffled hidden law labels.
architecture.GRU: R81 GRU64 on 5×13 legal raw A-event rows with tag-observation channel 8, standard trained comparator.
architecture.canonical_upper: Public-tag-only deterministic reordering of observed four noisy cues into selector/yes/no/distractor positions and existing R87 8D MLP; explicitly supplied invariant role mapping is a diagnostic engineered upper, not autonomous invention.

evaluation.confound_note: A tag-permuted arm preserves other signal (expected private law agreement 0.625), so strong difference supports binding utility but not independent causal-information deletion. This was frozen preimplementation following exact combinatorial enumeration before new panels existed.
